component.name: LCOS Notes
component.summary: Write and read linked Markdown notes offline

description.p: LCOS Notes is a native desktop editor for a folder of Markdown notes. Follow wikilinks and Markdown note links, search your vault, browse tags and backlinks, and read formatted notes without leaving the keyboard.
Your notes remain ordinary local files. No accounts or network connection are required.
Parent tags and tag rename, search options, folder and attachment rename, unlinked mentions and keyboard usability improvements.
Markdown note links, block references and NFC name matching.
Work-area sizing, reading navigation and caret preservation improvements.
Reading view, resizable backlinks columns and desktop packaging.
